classifications.rationale: The Secretary of Defense must undertake appropriate operational measures, but retains discretion over the steps used; the segment does not itself alter legal status or dictate a later agency legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: take all appropriate steps to disperse all persons engaged in the acts of violence

classifications.rationale: The segment grants discretionary operational authority to use military forces as the Secretary considers necessary.

classifications.rationale: The segment directs the Secretary to produce a later, specified legally consequential result by calling National Guard units or members into active federal military service, while leaving selection and timing discretion.
classifications.evidence: authorized and directed to call into the active military service of the United States

classifications.rationale: The segment authorizes discretionary operational use of units already called or recalled, without itself changing their status or mandating a new legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: authorized to use units and members called or recalled into the active military service
